title: Bread is cool
description: This mod adds various baked goods🍞🥐🥖🫓. It will be updated in the future.
body: This mod adds bread, bread, and even more bread. You can now roast bread over a campfire, and then roast it again. You can make a baguette and bake it in the oven. I might add more types of bread in the future. If you have any ideas for new types of bread, please send them to me at helifanu@gmail.com. Thank you Mcreator.
